claims.text: EHP Resort & Marina is a nine-acre waterfront resort, marina and wedding destination inspired by a modern Mediterranean ethos.

findings.quote: EHP Resort & Marina is a striking nine-acre waterfront resort, marina, and wedding destination inspired by a modern Mediterranean ethos.

claims.text: The resort sits on the edge of Three Mile Harbor and centers around its marina.

findings.quote: Nestled on the tranquil edge of Three Mile Harbor
The resort centers around the marina

claims.text: The resort is at 295 Three Mile Harbor Hog Creek Road in East Hampton, New York.

findings.quote: 295 Three Mile Harbor Hog Creek Rd, East Hampton, NY 11937

claims.text: The property was formerly East Hampton Point.

findings.quote: While it retains the classic Hamptons charm of the former East Hampton Point

claims.text: Accommodations combine modern minimalism with subtle Mediterranean touches and a calming palette.

findings.quote: Think modern minimalism infused with subtle Mediterranean touches, a calming palette, and an emphasis on elevated comfort.

claims.text: The resort offers private cottage accommodations.

findings.quote: private cottage accommodations

claims.text: The restaurant Si Si is inspired by coastal Mediterranean dining, with flavors of Italy, Greece, Spain, Morocco and beyond.

findings.quote: Inspired by coastal Mediterranean dining experiences, Si Si, or “yes yes,” in both Italian and Spanish, immerses you in the sun-kissed flavors of Italy, Greece, Spain, Morocco and beyond.

claims.text: The resort has a pool, a tennis court and plenty of outdoor space for children.

findings.quote: EHP caters to families well, with spacious accommodations, a beautiful pool, a tennis court, and plenty of outdoor space for kids to run around.

claims.text: The resort can arrange babysitting services.

findings.quote: The resort can also arrange for babysitting services

claims.text: The concierge can book dinner reservations and arrange boat charters.

findings.quote: The concierge can assist with everything from booking dinner reservations to arranging boat charters.

claims.text: Charters can stop for a swim at a secluded beach and cruise by the local lighthouses of Long Island's East End.

findings.quote: Stop for a swim at a secluded beach, cruise by the local lighthouses, and enjoy the beauty of Long Island's East End.

claims.text: The resort meets ADA standards, with accessible rooms and facilities throughout the property.

findings.quote: EHP meets ADA standards, with accessible rooms and facilities throughout the property.

claims.text: The Magari Harbor House suites have Carrara marble bathrooms and rooftop decks.

findings.quote: the Magari Harbor House suites, prized for their Carrara marble bathrooms, rooftop decks, and design-forward interiors

claims.text: The marina overlooks Three Mile Harbor and lets guests traveling by yacht dock and dine.

findings.quote: Overlooking Three Mile Harbor, EHP’s impressive marina will provides ultimate accessibility for those traveling to EHP by yacht, enabling the yachting community to dock and dine.

claims.text: Resort guests can design their own boat charter or choose from the captain's preferred experiences.

findings.quote: Resort guests can design their own charter or choose from a variety of the captain's preferred experiences.

claims.text: The one- and two-bedroom cottages have fully equipped kitchens and generous living spaces.

findings.quote: the one- and two-bedroom cottages, conveniently containing fully-equipped kitchens and generous living spaces

claims.text: Rooms have Assouline travel books, Acqua di Parma bath products, Frette linens and Vitruvi diffusers.

findings.quote: Assouline travel tomes, Acqua di Parma bath products, Frette linens, and Vitruvi diffusers signal the resort’s quiet attention to detail.

claims.text: The resort is on Three Mile Harbor rather than in the village; East Hampton Village, with its boutiques and restaurants, is within 15 minutes by car.

findings.quote: EHP's location on Three Mile Harbor offers a sense of tranquility
the allure of East Hampton Village, with its chic boutiques and acclaimed restaurants, is accessible within 15 minutes by car.

claims.text: Si Si reservations can be scarce over the summer months, so booking ahead is advised.

findings.quote: Be sure to book Sí Sí in advance, as reservations can be scarce over the summer months.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the exclusive Hamptons location.
